title: Malicious code in @xzvbailss/xz-protect (npm)
description: The npm package '@xzvbailss/xz-protect' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, clean computer. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software or full remediation, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
